input_source.description: Device or file to recover. E.g., /dev/sdb or /path/to/image.iso

output_file.description: File where to write recovered data. This file should not already exist.

retries_normal.description: Number of retries before going on with next sector (Normal mode). Default is 6.

retries_raw.description: Number of retries while reading in RAW mode before going on with next sector. Default is 6.

rotation_speed.description: Rotation speed of CDROM/DVD. Default is 1.

start_offset.description: Point to start recovery (sector offset). Default is 0.

skip_blocks_count.description: How many sectors are skipped after non-read one. Default is 1.

sectors_file.description: Generates a mapfile containing checksums and a list of bad sectors. Used with mergebad. Leave empty if not using.
